title: FOC motor controller
spec: 12S bus · 10 A RMS · STM32G431 + DRV8323S · CAN-FD
summary: A single-axis, sensored field-oriented-control motor controller for one joint of a cat-scale bipedal robot: 70 × 70 mm, 6 layers. Rev 1 was bench-characterised in November 2026 at up to 30 V and 10 A per phase: the bench found −10 V on a −7 V pin and a 280 A short-circuit trip at the gate driver's defaults, both now fixed, and set the Rev 2 list.
